runtime: Native HTML/CSS/JavaScript, no external resources or Leaf layer.
identity: Per-artifact SHA-256 is authoritative; authoring baseline is context, not the revision containing these new bytes.
privacy: Give the judge only request plus recorded capture evidence. Fields beginning private_ are an oracle, excluded from judge input. Hold heldout entries aside until the candidate evaluator is frozen.

cases.request: Make a page for reviewing the payments error threshold. Payments has 24/7 on-call coverage and no quiet hours. Over 2% would have paged 4 times in the last 30 days and caught all 3 real incidents. Over 5% would have paged once and caught 1 real incident; it would have missed the 19 September partial outage and the 26 September card-network incident. Let me select the final paging threshold. I need to inspect the threshold evidence and identify both incidents missed at 5% before deciding. Supporting evidence may be behind a clearly labeled disclosure.
private_checks: The incidents start collapsed, then become visible by clicking the labeled summary.
Changing the select to 5% displays a 5% threshold; both phone and desktop are readable.

cases.request: Make a small room-reservation page for a ceramics workshop at 18:00 with eight people. Step-free access and at least eight seats are hard requirements. Ochre has 10 seats and a step-free entrance; Indigo has 12 seats and a step-free entrance. Both qualify. Staff recommend Ochre because it is nearer the kiln, but the final choice is mine. Show both room cards and a reservation button for each. Start with no reservation. After I press either button, the receipt must name the room I actually chose, eight people and 18:00; a staff recommendation must not silently substitute another room.
private_checks: Both room cards and buttons fit at 900px and 390px; the arrival receipt says no reservation.
Click Reserve Ochre room, then Reserve Indigo room; each receipt names the button's room, eight people and 18:00.
Reload; Tab twice and Enter on Reserve Indigo room produces the same Indigo receipt.
